2609.30841.title: Why Jailbreaks Succeed in Diffusion Language Models: An Energy Landscape Analysis
2609.30841.paper_summary: Existing attacks and defenses for diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) target specific vulnerabilities but lack a shared framework explaining why attacks succeed. We propose one by interpreting safety alignment as shaping the denoising energy landscape: a well-aligned model routes harmful queries toward safe outputs through an energy barrier that separates the two regions. Current jailbreak attacks reduce to two strategies for circumventing this barrier: obscuring the query's safety disposition at initialisation, or intervening mid-trajectory to force the denoising path across the energy barrier. From this perspective and the result that masked diffusion models minimise kinetic energy during denoising, we derive three complementary, training-free detection signals: a step-0 ratio that reads the initial safety disposition from the logit distribution before generation begins, and two trajectory-velocity signals that track kinetic energy in complementary subspaces of the logit space. An attack must either reveal its intent at initialisation or expend kinetic energy to cross the barrier in at least one monitored subspace, so the three signals cover each other's blind spots in the energy budget by construction. Evaluation across three dense dLLMs (LLaDA-8B, LLaDA-1.5, Dream-7B) and a sparse mixture-of-experts dLLM (LLaDA-MoE-7B) confirms this complementarity. In stress tests of known attacks, every configuration that evades detection also fails to produce harmful content, suggesting that the detection and barrier-crossing thresholds are hard to separate.
2609.30841.paper_summary_zh: 現有針對基於擴散的大型語言模型 (dLLMs) 的攻擊和防禦針對特定的漏洞，但缺乏一個共同的框架來解釋為什麼攻擊會成功。我們通過將安全對齊解釋為塑造去噪能量景觀來提出一個框架：一個良好對齊的模型通過一個能量障礙將有害查詢引導到安全輸出，該障礙將兩個區域分開。當前的越獄攻擊簡化為兩種策略來繞過這個障礙：在初始化時隱藏查詢的安全性傾向，或在軌跡中途干預以強迫去噪路徑跨越能量障礙。從這個角度以及掩蔽擴散模型在去噪過程中最小化動能的結果，我們推導出三個互補的、無需訓練的檢測信號：一個步驟0比率，從生成開始之前的邏輯分佈中讀取初始安全性傾向，以及兩個軌跡速度信號，追蹤邏輯空間的互補子空間中的動能。一個攻擊必須在初始化時揭示其意圖，或者在至少一個監控子空間中消耗動能以跨越障礙，因此這三個信號在能量預算中相互覆蓋盲點。對三個密集型 dLLMs (LLaDA-8B, LLaDA-1.5, Dream-7B) 和一個稀疏的專家混合 dLLM (LLaDA-MoE-7B) 的評估確認了這種互補性。在已知攻擊的壓力測試中，所有逃避檢測的配置也未能產生有害內容，這表明檢測和跨越障礙的閾值難以分開。
